milestone: MCP dashboard accelerated status-colour transition acceptance
objective: Physically verify the production green/yellow/red/grey dashboard states on the exact Ditoo using a test-only virtual clock; production 5/20-minute thresholds remain unchanged.
why_this_shape: 006 was a clean idle-hold pass but no source event occurred, so animation was not exercised. 007 keeps the same accepted transport/pacing envelope and changes only the test procedure: after the operator starts the session, the assistant performs one harmless read-only WSL_MCP call, which appends a genuine completed WSL_MCP audit record that the existing collector should observe.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.connection_shape: one persistent RFCOMM connection for this bounded session; one ACK per frame; no retry or reconnect
transport.one_controller_rule: the Android Divoom app must be disconnected for the whole session; OpenTivoo runtime/task/port 8779 remain untouched

build.installed_identity_note: Carried forward from verified deployment immediately before 003/004: repository and installed DLL byte-identical at this hash. 005 changes WSL Python only; Windows Host source/binary is unchanged, so no rebuild is required.

session.activation_source: test-only virtual clock through the production activity_render.status_for logic; no MCP source collection
session.shape: one connection; deterministic green 0-3 s, yellow 3-6 s, red 6-9 s, grey from 9 s onward; change-only sends; Host hard floor 150 ms; nominal client cadence 200 ms; then close
session.semantic_evidence: No new device command semantics. The acceptance renderer feeds representative virtual ages into the unchanged production status renderer; grey is produced by removing usable activity data, not by inventing a fourth age threshold.

budgets.derivation: Expected exactly 4 changed frames (green/yellow/red/grey). Hard ceiling 8 frames; 8 * 3 packets; worst-case 203 application bytes per frame gives 1624 bytes.
budgets.expected_realistic_frames: exactly 4 unless the session is interrupted by stock takeover or transport fault

stop_immediately_on: any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
pairing precheck failure or any conflicting controller on the link
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed/unknown bytes and last known display state; never resend, reconnect, or reclaim
stop_policy.recovery: operator-initiated only after outcome is recorded; returning to stock is never a command we send

expected_observations.physical: approved L/mushroom, O/bunny, W/skull dashboard; on activity, that column crown + letter + icon accent visibly cycle cyan -> blue -> light blue -> cyan over four ACKed stages (~0.60 s) then return to status colour
expected_observations.stock_yield: after the operator has seen a full pulse, one physical Ditoo control is pressed; the session should stop immediately, send no reclaim frame, and report unknown_not_ours / stopped_yielded_to_stock
expected_observations.fault_bar: if a source genuinely becomes unavailable, its crown row shows the red fault bar and no activity crown; otherwise remains NOT TESTED
expected_observations.ack_payload: recorded per frame, never treated as a success constant
expected_observations.animation_expectation: one activity event visibly sweeps cyan → blue → light-blue → cyan three times over about 2 seconds, with crown + identity letter + icon accent changing together

acceptance_criteria.green: operator clearly sees all three source columns in production green for about 3 seconds
acceptance_criteria.yellow: operator clearly sees all three source columns change to production yellow for about 3 seconds
acceptance_criteria.red: operator clearly sees all three source columns change to production red for about 3 seconds
acceptance_criteria.grey: operator clearly sees all three source columns change to production grey; this stage means no usable activity data, not age > red
acceptance_criteria.order: visual order is green -> yellow -> red -> grey with no unexpected intermediate colours
acceptance_criteria.transport: one connection; one wrapped 0x44 ACK per completed changed frame; no 429 pacing fault; clean close
acceptance_criteria.production_semantics: production RECENT_LIMIT=5 min and WARM_LIMIT=20 min remain unchanged; acceptance uses only virtual time / no-data state
acceptance_criteria.authority_is_consumed: WSL claim and Host ledger make this experiment id one-use

preconditions: installed Host DLL remains the previously verified byte-identical build
offline verifier PASS at the commit being run
operator present and watching the unit

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution only: up to 15 seconds; deterministic MCP dashboard status-colour acceptance using the test-only virtual clock profile; exactly production rendering semantics; expected 4 changed frames and hard ceiling 8 frames / 24 packets / 1624 application bytes; one RFCOMM connection; ACK per frame; no MCP source collection, retry, reconnect, reclaim, pipelining, streaming, unattended operation, or second attempt.
authority.grant_scope: ONE execution only: up to 15 seconds; deterministic MCP dashboard status-colour acceptance using the test-only virtual clock profile; exactly production rendering semantics; expected 4 changed frames and hard ceiling 8 frames / 24 packets / 1624 application bytes; one RFCOMM connection; ACK per frame; no MCP source collection, retry, reconnect, reclaim, pipelining, streaming, unattended operation, or second attempt.

explicitly_out_of_scope: pipelining or more than one frame in flight
any frame-start policy faster than 150 ms
firmware update, persistent upload, service/MassBoot, teardown

supersedes.why: 005 grant is consumed; 006 is a fresh visual-only trial for the operator-requested longer animation.
